title: Home Slayer PPL
author: AtlonglastJshaw
desc: It's the Natural Hypertrophy Doom Slayer program but for a home gym wiht pull up bar and modifications

ss.note:
Hinge to 45°, back flat. 
Bar over mid-foot. 
Row to lower chest. 
Elbows drive back. 
Squeeze lats. 
No torso swing. 
Control down. 
Stay tight, stay hinged.

Seated,no back support
shoulders pinned back, golf ball
rep = 5 seconds: control  eccentric, feeling the stretch, then explode up
Fist points to ceiling but no further

Hinge at hips, chest over bar. 
Back flat, core tight. 
Grip low. 
Row to upper abs. 
Elbows back. 
Squeeze blades. 
Control down. 
Don’t stand tall — stay hinged.

Tuck chin, then lift head slowly to neutral. 
Squeeze at top. 
Lower under control. 
No bouncing. 
All in the neck.

Sit tall, neck long. 
Shrug straight up, no rolling. 
Squeeze traps hard at top. 
Slow 3s down. 
Arms are hooks, elbows soft. 
Control tension all the way.

Chest forward, elbows back. 
Lower slow to full stretch. 
Drive up hard. 
No locking out. 
Stay tight, no swing. 
Depth over ego.

Hinge deep.
Elbows flared.
Pull wide, bar to chest.
Focus on rear delts, not traps.
Squeeze.
Control each rep.
No torso bounce.

Elbows flared.
Palms face out.
Press up and out in an arc.
Don’t lock out.
Keep tension.
Control the descent.
Feel the shoulder stretch, not a shrug.

Soft elbows.
Raise to 45° from torso.
Don’t go higher.
Pinkies slightly up.
No swing.
Pause at the top.
Control the way down.

Chest tall.
Arms slightly bent.
Hug a barrel shape.
Squeeze pecs, don’t press.
Slow stretch at the end.
Control all the way.

Bar on traps.
Feet shoulder-width.
Slight knee bend.
Hinge at hips.
Back flat.
Lower until hamstring stretch.
Squeeze glutes to stand.
No lumbar rounding.

Sit, feet up or down.
Hold dumbbell at chest.
Rotate torso, not just arms.
Tap floor each side.
Keep abs braced.
Twist with control.
Don’t rush reps.

Feet hip-width.
Toes forward or slightly out.
Push through big toe.
Raise heels high.
Pause at top.
Lower slow with full stretch.
No bouncing.

Bar at thigh level.
Hinge slightly.
Explode up.
Shrug hard at top.
Use hips and traps together.
Lower under control.
Reset each rep.
No bounce reps.

Close or wide grip.
Elbows stay pinned.
Curl to chest height.
No swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Control the drop.
Full stretch at bottom.

Heavy dumbbell.
Support hand on bench.
Brace core.
Explode up.
Pull past ribs.
Squeeze back.
Controlled eccentric.

Forearms on bench or knees.
Wrists hang over.
Curl DB or bar with fingers.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slow.
Stretch fingers at bottom.
Light, focused burn.

Pull to forehead.
Elbows high and wide.
Squeeze rear delts and traps.
Pause.
Control the return.
No leaning back.

Barbell over chest.
Lower to mid-face/throat.
Elbows stay tucked.
Triceps lower bar.
Pause.
Drive up with triceps.
Don’t flare or bounce.

Palms in.
Elbows pinned.
Curl up smooth.
Squeeze biceps.
No shoulder swing.
Lower slow.
Stop just short of lockout.

Plate on back of head.
Chin tucked.
Lift head to neutral.
No torso movement.
Lower slow.
Feel rear neck work.

Incline bench - 30 dgs
Arms soft and wide.
Lower in arc until stretch.
Don’t overextend.
Squeeze chest to raise.
No pressing.
Control the entire rep.

Hold plate at chest.
Brace abs.
Crunch up, not forward.
Slow, tight reps.
Don’t yank neck.
Pause at top.
Control down fully.

Feet hip-width.
Grip just outside legs.
Hinge at hips, soft knees.
Bar stays close.
Stretch hamstrings.
Back flat.
Drive hips through to stand.

Hinge over, back flat.
Arms hang under chest.
Raise out wide in arc.
Elbows soft.
Pause at top.
Control the return.
No momentum.

Upper back on bench.
Feet under knees.
Bar over hips.
Brace core.
Drive hips up.
Squeeze glutes hard.
Pause at top.
Lower slow.
